description: This PHP source file defines the class LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration, which configures LDAP authentication settings, commands, and scheduling within the OrangeHRM system. The class implements plugin, console, and scheduler configuration interfaces, and uses traits for dependency injection and configuration management. Key functionalities include initializing LDAP logging, adding LDAP authentication provider, registering LDAP sync commands, and scheduling periodic LDAP user synchronization based on configuration settings.

classes.name: LDAPAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Main configuration class for LDAP authentication within the plugin, responsible for initializing services, registering commands, and scheduling LDAP sync tasks based on system settings.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up LDAP logging and adds LDAP authentication provider if LDAP is enabled in settings.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers LDAP synchronization command to the console.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules periodic LDAP user synchronization based on configured interval if LDAP is enabled.
